title: wmw-great-lakes
label: Dess

won.source: The fed's own champions page: "Dess took back his title… Longest Reign: Dess (2 month)(2 defenses)" — naming a Dess reign distinct from the one 'taken back' on 13 June 2003, since he is described as regaining rather than winning it fresh. Neither this reign's own start nor end date survives, nor its place in the lineage relative to Sub-Beast's own first reign.

note: Gap-registered: the champions page attests this reign (its own longest on the title, two months, two defences) without dating it or naming who it was lost to. It is placed here, before Tami Weber's own reign and after Sub-Beast's, because Dess is described as taking the title back FROM Tami Weber rather than from a longer-reigning champion — not because the record states this order outright.
